_doc.how: Named parameter sets for px4/fly_forest.py. 'base' inherits another set. Any key can also be overridden per batch: python -m px4.forest_eval --configs NAME --param goal_gap=0
_doc.brain: none (route following, no avoidance, flies through obstacles) | lplc2 | old
_doc.sac_v: forward speed fraction while the closed-loop turn runs (0 = turn in place)
_doc.front: half-width of the frontal looming field, deg
_doc.sac_rate: saccade rate the brain plans with, deg/s (sets turn angles)
_doc.goal_gap: weight of 'steer for the open gap nearest the goal' (0 = plain goal bearing)
_doc.goal_thr: turn toward the goal only when it is more than this many deg off
_doc.rot_gate: gyro gate: ignore vision while body yaw rate > this deg/s (null = off)
_doc.sac_speed: speed fraction the brain asks for while gated/settling
_doc.sac_end_wy: a turn ends when heading error < 10 deg and yaw rate < this deg/s
_doc.persist: looming frames in a row before a hazard is remembered
_doc.haz_expire: forget non-crash hazards after this many s (null = never)
_doc.veto_r: goal turns never point at a remembered hazard closer than this m
_doc.stall_s / stall_m: early stop: end the run if progress along the route grew < stall_m in stall_s seconds (null = off)
_doc.max_coll: early stop after this many collisions (null = off)
_doc.recovery: after a contact: flip (old: back off 0.6 s, turn ~180 deg) | detour (back off rec_back_s at rec_back_v, turn 90 deg to the freer side, slide rec_side_m, turn back, shift the route carrot sideways bypass_m for bypass_len m)
_doc.brake: off | loom | all: stop forward motion (speed < brake_v, max brake_max_s) before looming / all turns
_doc.flow_speed / flow_ref / v_min: speed governor: forward speed x clip(flow_ref / lateral optic flow, v_min, 1) (slow down in clutter, like bees and flies)
_doc.guard_side: during a forward detour leg, brake to a stop and abandon the leg if the forward range crosses the stop threshold
_doc.tof / tof_stop / tof_fov / tof_max: forward 1D range finder failsafe (VL53L1X-like cone): closer than tof_stop m -> brake + 90 deg escape turn
_doc.tof_t / tof_action: stop distance grows tof_t s x speed; tof_action turn (90 deg) | detour (brake, sidestep, bypass)
_doc.reacquire: outside the corridor by > half its width: carrot 2 m ahead on the route to get back in
_doc.creep_s / creep_v: look-then-go: after every turn fly at creep_v x speed for creep_s s (optic flow needs motion to see depth)
